subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear John, Thank you for applying for the Marketing Coordinator position at XYZ Company. We have received your application and would like to inform you that we are currently in the process of reviewing all applications. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and will notify you of the next steps in the coming weeks. If you have any questions in the meantime, please feel free to reach out. Best regards, Jane Smith, HR Manager
